name: Spooky Meta
summary: Spooky Meta is a horror-themed Gorilla Tag fan game that drops you into a dark, abandoned library filled with secrets—and something terrifying watching your every move. Play as a gorilla navigating through eerie halls, dusty bookshelves, and flickering lights, all while avoiding a floating monster that silently stalks the shadows. With only your agility and instincts to rely on, every step could be your last. Can you survive the darkness…
